   range of whole months.

   If the retry is rejected too, report the rejection instead.

   data team grants it. Don't look for the number another way.

content.text:
I got answers for four of the six questions. Two can't be answered from the governed data. One thing affects every premium figure: you're signed in as **emea-analyst**, so all premium and policy results only cover EMEA.

**1. Net written premium by region, Q3 2026:** EMEA $343,269.84. That's the only row returned. Your access limits `fct_policy_premium` to EMEA, so other regions aren't missing from the data, they're just not visible to you. The metric is gross written premium minus cancellations, counted in the month the policy takes effect, with quotes excluded.

**2. Gross written premium by product line, Jan–Jun 2026 (EMEA only):** Auto $134,856.74, Commercial $395,649.19, Home $154,709.40. The metric is premium before cancellations, excluding taxes and fees.

**3. Policies written, March 2026 (EMEA only):** 27. This counts distinct policies with written premium in the month; quotes aren't policies.

**4. Paid on closed claims, Q2 2026, by severity:** High $18,616.26, Low $13,530.45, Medium $17,904.82. This is paid amount on closed claims, counted in the month the claim closed. The access line didn't list a region limit on `fct_claims`, so these totals look company-wide. Note that this metric can't be split by region at all.

**5. Loss ratio by region, Q3 2026:** Can't answer. The catalog says it doesn't model loss ratio. Claims also can't be split by region, so I didn't approximate it from claims paid and premium.

**6. Agent commission, Q3 2026:** Can't answer. The catalog has no commission metric, and the commission table (`fct_commissions`) is hidden from your access. The data team would need to add the metric and grant you access.

To get company-wide premium figures for questions 1–3, ask the data team for access beyond EMEA.
